summary: Iteration 2 focused on the httpOnly-cookie auth migration, the ClientDetail split and role guards. Backend: 53 pytest cases (existing backend_test.py 40 + new test_rbac_scoping.py 8 + test_privilege_escalation.py 1) -> 51 passed, 2 failed, both proving the SAME security defect: POST /api/users is not admin-only, so a 'negozio' user can create an 'operatore' account with can_view_all=true and then read all 488 clients (verified end-to-end: michael 432 clients -> escalated account 488). Frontend (admin): login sets httpOnly+secure cookie gu_token, NO app token in localStorage, document.cookie does not expose gu_token, session survives reload, navigation Dashboard->Clienti->Negozi->Operatori->Utenti->WhatsApp keeps the session, logout clears the cookie and /clienti afterwards redirects to /login. ClientDetail sheet after the split renders all expected testids (timeline contratto/attivazione/rinnovo/scadenza, confronto tariffe, storico lavorazioni, whatsapp-card + wa-privacy/wa-review, attachments-card, mark-paid/edit/delete). Create -> edit -> mark-paid (badge Non pagato -> Pagato) -> delete all work; Esporta Excel downloads report_clienti_2026-09-04.xlsx; WhatsApp page shows 'Non connesso' + QR. Negozio (michael): sees only own stores (432/488, API-verified no client outside his store_ids), sidebar hides Negozi/Operatori/WhatsApp, /negozi /operatori /whatsapp all redirect to / (route guards now working - iteration 1 defect fixed), /utenti still reachable and exposes the create-user form. All QA data was removed afterwards (488 clients / 5 users, the client touched by mark-paid was reset to Non pagato).

critical.issue: PRIVILEGE ESCALATION: endpoint uses Depends(get_current_user) and only blocks role='admin'. Any authenticated user (negozio) can create an 'operatore' / 'negozio' account with can_view_all=true and arbitrary store_ids, then log in with it and read every client (proved: 432 -> 488). Must require admin (require_admin) or at minimum forbid role!=negozio, can_view_all and stores outside the caller's own store_ids.

minor.issue: CORS_ORIGINS="*" makes allow_credentials=False. Cookie auth only works because frontend and backend share the origin; per the auth playbook it should list explicit origins (FRONTEND_URL) with allow_credentials=True.
Returns 502 while no number is linked (expected in this env). UI shows the Italian toast 'Invio WhatsApp fallito' correctly.
Still open from iteration 1: login_attempts.count is not reset when the 15-min lock expires, so one further failed attempt re-locks immediately.
Still open from iteration 1: PATCH validates the full ClientInput, omitted fields fall back to defaults (PUT semantics).

ui_bugs.issue: A 'negozio' user can open /utenti, click 'Nuovo utente' and the Ruolo select offers 'Operatore' - combined with the backend defect above this is an escalation path from the UI. The page also renders a completely blank area (no users table, no message) because GET /api/users 403 is only fetched when isAdmin.
Console warning 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' on the client form dialog (a11y).

integration_issues.issue: Clicking wa-review-button right after wa-privacy-button produced the 502 request but no visible toast in the run (first toast still occupying the slot); privacy send did toast correctly. Worth double-checking toast de-duplication.

issues: Whole content area empty below the header - only the 'Nuovo utente' button; needs an explanatory empty state or the route should be admin-only

action_items: CRITICAL: protect POST /api/users with require_admin (and/or validate role/can_view_all/store_ids against the caller) - a negozio user can currently mint an operatore account that sees all 488 clients.
Hide the create-user form for non-admins in Utenti.jsx (or make /utenti admin-only) and remove 'Operatore' from the role select for non-admins; add an empty/permission state instead of a blank page.
Set CORS_ORIGINS to the explicit frontend origin so allow_credentials=True is used with the cookie auth.
Carry over from iteration 1: reset login_attempts.count after the lock window; PATCH /api/clients partial-update semantics; add DialogTitle to dialogs.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:349 create_user uses get_current_user instead of require_admin - only the 'admin' role is blocked, every other role can create privileged accounts (can_view_all=true bypasses store scoping entirely).
Utenti.jsx gates the users table on isAdmin but not the creation dialog, mirroring the backend hole on the client side.
server.py is now 1412 lines (auth, email, parser, whatsapp, export, seed) - split into routers/services; the ClientDetail extraction on the frontend is a good precedent.
Cookie is set with samesite='lax' + secure=True and gu_token is unreadable from JS - migration verified correct.

Route guards for /negozi /operatori /whatsapp now redirect negozio users to /; /utenti is still open. WhatsApp send returns 502 by design (number not linked).
rca_of_the_issue: POST /api/users depends on get_current_user and only rejects input.role == 'admin'. Because 'operatore' (and can_view_all=true) bypass the store scoping applied in GET /api/clients, any negozio account can self-escalate in two calls (create user -> login). Frontend Utenti.jsx compounds it by rendering the creation dialog for every authenticated role with 'Operatore' selectable. Fix by switching the dependency to require_admin; if shop owners must create their own staff, restrict role to 'negozio', force can_view_all=False and intersect store_ids with the caller's store_ids.
